name: Ooyamada Tamayo
source: Maid of house hold, said to have worked in mansion for 10 years. Is very friendly and kind, Yasuhiro saying she is only woman at mansion he can calm talk to and relax. Despite her appearance she is much older than she looks but will act childish at times.
